methods.timings: Wall-clock microseconds with conversion, update, division and query timed separately.
methods.bytes: Actual serialized DAG size including one record per reachable node.
methods.random_recursive_bases: Positive recursive exponents with randomly signed terms and independently sampled root signs. Distinct positions are multiples of four. Shared templates use a separately seeded pool.
methods.oracle: Independent raw expression evaluation using the observed powers-of-two residue cycle. Prime cases fold explicit fixture IDs modulo the query modulus.
methods.adaptive_eager: Allow up to 1,000 signed normalization work units. Return the smaller of the eager and deferred results.
methods.prime_updates: Sequential product of distinct sampled IDs. The unmined factor-tree lane runs every checkpoint. Stage medians include updates since the previous checkpoint.
methods.division: Pure checked division validates divisibility by residue. Adaptive division uses a retained, already-packed exact factor. For the first seed in each deep configuration, canonical division recovers the pure quotient from only the two normalized input markings.

prime_products.sampling: Seeded SymPy isprime rejection sampling of distinct 129-bit odd integers.
